title: synthcheck: Tests How Authentic Synthetic Survey Respondents Look
description:
An R package that tests whether synthetic respondents generated by large language models resemble the real survey respondents they are meant to stand in for. Overlap shows whether synthetic respondents land where real people land, Structure whether the items relate to each other as they do in real people, and Behaviour whether synthetic respondents answer the way people do (variability, extreme and midpoint answers, acquiescence, consistency and person fit). Each index is anchored between a shuffled baseline and a second sample of real people, and the synthetic authenticity benchmark compares several models in one table. The package includes real and synthetic responses to the IPIP-HEXACO personality inventory, and a Shiny app that generates synthetic respondents with Anthropic, OpenAI or local Ollama models and benchmarks them.

The package is experimental: It compares models and supports decisions about them. It does not show that synthetic data can replace a field test.
